gloss: healthy body; state of good health

definitions.gloss: healthy body; state of good health; clean bill of health
definitions.explanation: A body that is in good physical health with no medical problems. Often used when describing someone who has been medically cleared or is in excellent physical condition.

examples.japanese: {検査|けんさ}の{結果|けっか}、{健康体|けんこうたい}だと{言|い}われた。
examples.english: After the examination, I was told I have a clean bill of health.

examples.japanese: {健康体|けんこうたい}を{維持|いじ}するには{運動|うんどう}が{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Exercise is essential to maintaining a healthy body.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は70{歳|さい}を{過|す}ぎても{健康体|けんこうたい}で、{毎日|まいにち}ジョギングをしている。
examples.english: Even past 70, he is in good health and jogs every day.

notes:
{健康体|けんこうたい} refers to a body in good physical condition with no medical issues. A compound of {健康|けんこう} (healthy) + {体|たい} (body).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {健康体|けんこうたい}を{維持|いじ}する: to maintain a healthy body
- {健康体|けんこうたい}に{戻|もど}る: to return to a healthy state
- {健康体|けんこうたい}である: to be in good health

USAGE:
Often used in medical contexts, especially after checkups or physical examinations. A typical pattern is {検査|けんさ}の{結果|けっか}、{健康体|けんこうたい}だと{分|わ}かった (the examination showed a clean bill of health).

CONTRAST:
Compare with {健康|けんこう} (general health), which is broader and can include mental well-being. {健康体|けんこうたい} focuses specifically on the physical body being free of illness.
